help.title: 📖 Idle Factory Commands
help.intro: An idle management game where you build factories, produce materials, and sell them. Click any command below to run it right away.

gettingStarted.title: 🚀 New here?
gettingStarted.body:
1. Register the bot on your server with `/setup`.
2. Check your land with `/land view`, then build on an empty slot with `/factory build`.
3. Wait a while, then collect what you produced with `/harvest`.
4. Sell materials with `/market sell` and reinvest the money into more factories.

entries.factory: Build, upgrade, inspect, or destroy your factories.
entries.harvest: Harvest all of your factories at once.
entries.land: View your land, buy new plots, and unlock locked slots.
entries.market: List, sell, and buy materials, and check global prices.
entries.profile: Check your assets and factory overview.
entries.server: View the server vault and set the announcement channel.
entries.stock: List your factories as stocks and trade server shares.
entries.warehouse: Check your warehouse and upgrade its grade.
entries.ping: Check the bot's latency and uptime.
entries.language: Pick the language the bot replies to you in.
entries.setup: Set the bot up on this server for the first time.
entries.admin: Operators only — adjust guild credit and market listings.
entries.debug: Developers only — manipulate your own game state.
entries.attributes: Developers only — roll the attribute gacha.
entries.공지: Developers only — send or delete a notice.

help.unknownCategory: No such category. Run the command without a category to see everything.
